status: ReAct agents (plain Python and LangGraph); same prompt rules, validator and LLM as generate_v1; settings are dev-tuned only until a freeze file says otherwise

abstain.note: G4: null = no score gate; only the model's own abstain flag and the validator can abstain

recover.note: L13 p46 Recover: used only by the graph version (src/ncdqa/rag/graph.py); 0 = no retry, the plain pipeline never retries

flagged_chunks_note: G6: keep = send chunks with injection_flags to the model (flags are only recorded); exclude = drop them before the prompt

agent.note: decision R1 (AI-suggested): rounds of tool calls capped by max_steps, 3 calls per round, search returns search_k chunks (frozen variant B); tools search + calculator (R2). Options added after the dev diagnosis (all off here, switched on with --set): seed_search (harness searches the user's own question first), fuse_original (RRF of the model's query and the user's question), consolidate_k (final answer may cite only the top-k chunks by cumulative RRF), stop_when_no_new (a search with nothing new ends the searching)
